Hi Alex / Sara —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed set of next steps to keep the trial-to-paid path moving: 

Call recap (short):
- Success criteria: demo the Redwood inference API integrated into Acme's ticket routing pipeline, 30% reduction in manual categorization by week 3, and stable latency under 150ms p50 for typical prompts.
- Trial seats: initial pilot for 10 devs, expected 1M tokens over 30 days per your estimate.

Procurement + commercial questions we discussed and next asks:
1) Paper process: will Acme purchase via Purchase Order (PO) or corporate card?
2) Marketplace interest: are you interested in transacting via AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace or direct invoicing?
3) Billing start date: what date should we schedule for billing to begin (end of trial vs specific start date)?
4) Required paperwork: if you need a SOW/PO template, we can send draft terms.

I've attached a short guide on common MOPs (redwood-trial-mop-guidance.pdf) that summarizes PO vs card, typical lead times, and options for marketplace purchases.

Proposed next steps:
- Alex: confirm procurement preference (PO vs card) and key contact at procurement (if different from this thread).
- We (Marissa + David + Monica): send SOW draft / commercial terms and estimate timeline for invoicing.
- Sync up next week if helpful (15-20 min).

Thanks —

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 
- Procurement preference: Acme prefers to use PO for anything above $5k. For pilots under $5k we can sometimes use a corporate card. Estimated pilot spend looks like it may be ~ $4-6k depending on token volume.
- Marketplace: we are evaluating Marketplace options (AWS), but procurement would still want a PO on record for our internal tracking. If you have a marketplace SKU that's fine but we will still need paperwork.
- Billing start: we'd prefer billing to start at the end of the trial, unless we sign a PO earlier. If a PO is sent in advance we can set the billing date to the PO effective date.

Procurement contact: procurement@acme.com (I'm looping them on a follow-up). I can also get you a PO template if helpful.

On security: our security team will ask for SOC2 attestation and data processing details — happy to set up a 15-min sync with your security/contact.

Regards,
Alex
Product Manager, Acme Corp

Following up and attaching a draft SOW and our standard commercial terms to speed review. Short summary of options: 
- Option A (PO): You submit a PO referencing the SOW and we invoice net 30 on acceptance. PO lead time typically 5-10 business days depending on approvals.
- Option B (Card / Direct): We can accept card payments for faster turnaround; we will auto-bill at the agreed start date unless a PO is submitted prior.
- Option C (Marketplace): If you'd like AWS Marketplace, we can provide a listing and you can transact there; procurement still likes a PO for internal records.

Attached: acme-po-template.pdf (example PO format), redwood-sow-draft.docx (SOW draft). Let me know which path you prefer and any changes needed on the SOW.

Hi Alex / procurement team —

Thanks for the answers. From a commercial ops perspective we recommend the following path to minimize delays: 

1) Pilot period: 30 days starting when Acme provisions tokens. We will not invoice during the pilot unless a PO is submitted to us before the end of the pilot.
2) Billing: if no PO received by the pilot end date, Redwood will auto-convert to a paid subscription billed to the card on file or to the payment method you choose. If a PO is submitted before pilot end date we will invoice per PO terms (net 30 by default).
3) PO lead time: plan for 5-7 business days to get PO processed once submitted to procurement.
4) Security requests: SOC2 AICPA report is available; Marissa will share our security pack and we can coordinate a short call with our security engineer if needed.

Deal details: Deal ID RW-ACME-2026-001. Attached our commercial terms v2 for quick review (redwood-commercial-terms-v2.pdf).

Next steps: 
- Acme: confirm whether procurement will submit PO and an estimated submission date.
- Redwood: we will circulate finalized SOW and provide SOC2 pack.
